packageRules.description: Wait 3 days before any automerged update, so a broken or yanked release is usually fixed or pulled before it lands. Overrides the shared preset's digest/patch groups, which automerge at once.

github-actions: minor bumps in their own PR, merged once CI is green after the 3-day wait. Majors stay in the preset's group, for review. Split so a major never holds a minor back, or rides along with it.
pre-commit: minor bumps in their own PR, merged once CI is green after the 3-day wait. Majors are for review.
Non-major Python and npm updates merge once CI is green after the 3-day wait. Nothing here is uptime-critical, and CI runs the whole suite.
Tool versions pinned in workflow inputs (zizmor and the like): non-major bumps merge once CI is green after the 3-day wait.
pytest-homeassistant-custom-component pins the HA build the tests run against, which also decides aiohue's version (below). Its own PR, labelled, for review.
Anything that changes the integration's manifest.json is for review: it is what HACS and HA read.
Python follows Home Assistant's minimum: hold below 3.15 until HA moves, then raise this with requires-python, ruff's target-version and pyupgrade's --pyXY-plus in one PR.
ruff and its pre-commit hook move together in one PR, for review, so the linter CI runs never disagrees with the one in .venv.
aiohue must equal what HA's hue manifest requires in the HA build pytest-homeassistant-custom-component pins, which Renovate can't see: bump it by hand with that package.
